reason: An Android application testing plugin that combines screenshot-based vision analysis with adb-driven UI inspection and real device actions, including taps, gestures, input, app installation, and launch.

summaries.zh: 通过视觉模型分析 Android 截图，并使用 adb 检查界面、执行点击滑动输入及应用安装启动，用于移动应用测试。
summaries.en: Analyzes Android screenshots with a configurable vision model and uses adb for UI inspection, taps, gestures, input, app installation, and launch during mobile application testing.

capabilities: Sends local screenshots to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision API
Captures Android screenshots and UI hierarchy through adb
Performs real taps, swipes, text input, and key events on Android devices
Installs APKs and launches Android applications through adb
Stores screenshots in a local directory
